_what_this_is: Rule 4 placement, assembled from our own measurements and RSI-Jev's published numbers. NOTHING here is computed across the two projects: each number is measured by the project that reports it, and the two are on different splits until the frozen comparison below is run.
_why_it_matters: RSI-Jev works on the SAME benchmark (typed-decisions, noul/choice/score) with the SAME task shape (one forward pass, a probability per option, no generation). It is therefore the closest external reference available, and its arm history is a record of which levers were tried on this task and what each was worth.

_our_measurement.split: medium -- 440 questions over 88 cases, carved from dev by whole case
_our_measurement.status: WORKING SET. The frozen test split has never been read by this project.
_our_measurement.trained: QLoRA r16 on typed-decisions train split (the ecosystem agent's own recipe)

_their_published.note: zero-shot: had never seen any benchmark's train split
+ benchmark train split (+0.12) + 15% general-knowledge replay; shipped as suite 0.7056
+ listwise NDCG@5 reranking RL over 16 candidates; +60% R@1 on hippo

_NOT_COMPARABLE_YET.reason: Our 0.7955 is on medium, a WORKING split derived from dev. Their 0.662 / 0.796 are on a held-out set (eval_final_v2). Comparing the two numbers directly would be comparing a selection set with a held-out set, which flatters whichever was selected on.
_NOT_COMPARABLE_YET.what_would_make_it_comparable: one read of our frozen test split (400 cases / 2000 questions), which the proposal reserves for pre-registered claims and Rule-4 comparison. That read has not happened and is the single measurement that would place us honestly.
